description: Median registered price per square foot, registered home sales over 12 months, off-plan share and gross rental yield for a named Dubai community, from the Dubai Land Department record. Homes only: excludes land, whole buildings, offices, shops and hotel inventory. Sales only: excludes mortgage and gift registrations.

community.description: Community name, for example 'Dubai Marina', 'Jumeirah Village Circle', 'Business Bay'.

title: Registered prices for a Dubai community
